retention: fixed upper edge pockets, corner guides and lower bridge spring clip
joint_type: 38-degree bayonet at all three shaft joints
button_insertion_direction: radially inward with side claws spread
button_socket_retention: recessed internal seat and small integral claws; wires carry no mounting load
button_mount_style: recessed socket seat with tiny side retaining claws; no projecting collar
lower_handle_join: matching direct inward arms with broad recessed seats and enlarged captured pegs

removable_loop.stem_mount_type: recessed keyhole cam sockets and broad matching shallow seats; all pegs and release hardware on removable loop
removable_loop.upright_load_stop: closed upper receiver ends; independent of release tongue
removable_loop.retention: radial keyhole entry, 4mm upward slide then 12-degree left cam turn; handle-carried release catch; no external stem mounts

airflow_direction: outside loop to inner finger-contact surface
grip_cross_section: oval around battery, circular above; 5mm shallower through hand area

design_principles.change_policy: Only a new explicit user instruction may change these relationships. A mechanism revision must not lift the loop or controls away from the butt.

window_architecture: curved leaf cells with rounded intersections and printable roofs, four wider/deeper rounded axial rails, full original spiral strips
perforation_policy: regular broad windows in a ribbed shell; preserve full raised helix, four axial rails, short cell connections and solid hardware zones
head_hollowing: retained hollow V6 shell and rail reinforcement, with self-supporting pocket struts

battery.note: Provisional cell envelope: measure the actual battery and use removable spacers before printing the handle.
